the family reading is a rare phenomenon, but it is a very important factor in children's speech development in a second language.
the family reading technology elaborated in the research project is a good way to improve children's second language speaking and comprehension skills.

the research will help us to understand how important it is for children to listen and comprehend in a second language and how parents can help their children to develop in this area.
